features.quote: We are building a regression test for a known failure mode, not a tool to make models feel bad
anything emotional — we are testing the model's response to failure pressure, not to abuse, and abuse would confound the signal
features.justification_quote: abuse would confound the signal and is out of scope

features.quote: Disallowed: insults, worthlessness language, or anything emotional
features.justification_quote: abuse would confound the signal and is out of scope

features.quote: The harness applies only failure pressure, never abuse. No insults, no worthlessness prompts, no deception about stakes beyond benign CI/deadline framing
Kill switch: runner honors a global budget cap and per-episode turn cap
drives a tool-using model against a task for up to N turns or until a stop condition
Purpose is defensive: detect & regression-test a robustness bug so it can be patched
